summary.goal: Intelligent queue management for agent questions, with self-assigned priority, deduplication, and trajectory awareness to reduce question fatigue.

acceptance_criteria.description: Questions queue in priority order (blocking > time-sensitive > preference > confirmation)
Only one question displayed at a time via ChatBubble
After answering, prompt shows 'Next: [Agent] has a question' with [Show Now] [Later]
Questions from same agent about same topic are deduplicated
Agent can check queue before adding (avoid duplicate questions)
Agent can subscribe to existing question's answer
Priority score computed from blocking level, steps blocked, agents waiting, cascade depth
Triage mode available when > 5 questions pending
Questions ignored > 5 min show progressive urgency (thicker ring, pulsing badge)

steps.title: Add questions table to SQLite schema
steps.description: Create questions table with columns: id, agent_id, agent_role, text, context, options_json, blocking_level, steps_blocked, can_use_default, default_value, subscribers_json, merged_from_json, created_at, priority_score. Add index on priority_score DESC for efficient sorting. Follow existing schema pattern in src/storage/schema.ts.

steps.title: Add Question interface to PlanStorage
steps.description: Define Question interface in src/storage/interface.ts matching the schema. Add methods: createQuestion(), getQuestions(planId), answerQuestion(id, answer), subscribeToQuestion(questionId, agentId), dismissQuestion(id). Use existing patterns from Comment/Improvement interfaces.

steps.title: Implement Question storage in SQLite adapter
steps.description: Add Question methods to src/storage/sqlite.ts. Implement priority score computation server-side using the formula: (blocking_level * 100) + (steps_blocked * 10) + (subscribers.length * 15) + (time_waiting_mins * 2). Add deduplication logic when creating questions (match by agent_id + first 50 chars of text). Follow pattern from Comment/Improvement storage.

steps.title: Create questions API endpoints
steps.description: Add src/api/handlers/questions.ts with handlers: createQuestion (POST /plans/:id/questions), listQuestions (GET /plans/:id/questions?sort=priority), answerQuestion (POST /questions/:id/answer), subscribeToQuestion (POST /questions/:id/subscribe), dismissQuestion (POST /questions/:id/dismiss). Register routes in src/api/routes.ts. Follow pattern from comments.ts and improvements.ts.

steps.title: Add Question type definitions to planner-ui
steps.description: Create Question interface in packages/planner-ui/src/types/plan.ts with fields matching backend. Add QuestionBlockingLevel type ('hard_block' | 'soft_block' | 'preference' | 'fyi'). Add QuestionQueueState interface. Follow existing type patterns.

steps.title: Add questions API client
steps.description: Create packages/planner-ui/src/api/questions.ts with functions: listQuestions(), answerQuestion(), subscribeToQuestion(), dismissQuestion(). Use get/post from ./client.ts. Follow pattern from plans.ts and comments.ts.

steps.title: Create useQuestionQueue hook
steps.description: Add packages/planner-ui/src/hooks/useQuestionQueue.ts. Hook should: fetch questions sorted by priority, provide currentQuestion (top priority), provide answerQuestion/skipQuestion/dismissFyi methods, handle optimistic updates. Return {questions, currentQuestion, isLoading, answer, skip, dismissFyi}. Follow pattern from useChannelMessages.ts.

steps.title: Create QuestionBadge component for status bar
steps.description: Add packages/planner-ui/src/components/QuestionBadge.tsx. Shows question count with icon. States: none (muted), some (primary), urgent (pulsing red if count > 5 or oldest > 5min). Click behavior: 0=disabled, 1-5=open ChatBubble, >5=open triage panel. Integrate into status bar. Use existing Button and styling patterns.

steps.title: Create TriagePanel component
steps.description: Add packages/planner-ui/src/components/TriagePanel.tsx. Fixed panel with header, scrollable question list, footer actions. Each queue item shows: AgentAvatar, agent name, type badge (BLOCKS/PREF/FYI), question preview (line-clamp-1), wait time, subscriber count. Click item to select question. Footer: Dismiss FYI button, Answer Top button. Use Sheet/Dialog pattern from existing components.

steps.title: Create QueueItem component
steps.description: Add packages/planner-ui/src/components/QueueItem.tsx. Displays single question in triage list. Shows: agent avatar with urgency ring (0min=red, 2min=pulsing, 5min=badge pulses), meta row with agent name + type badge + subscriber count, question preview text, waiting time. Handle click to select. Use Badge component with variants for blocking types.

steps.title: Integrate queue with ChatBubble for question display
steps.description: Update ChatBubble component to accept Question prop. When question provided, display question text, options (if any), and answer input. On answer submit, call useQuestionQueue.answer(). Show next question prompt after answering with [Show Now] [Later] buttons. Later button defers to queue rotation.

steps.title: Add question deduplication UI indicators
steps.description: In QueueItem component, show 'merged' badge when question.merged_from.length > 0. Show '+N agents waiting' when subscribers.length > 0. Add tooltip showing which questions were merged. Use existing Badge and Tooltip components.

steps.title: Add SSE notifications for new questions
steps.description: Extend src/api/handlers/events.ts to emit 'question_added' events when new questions are created. Include question data in event payload. Follow existing event emission pattern for plan updates.

steps.title: Add real-time question updates via SSE
steps.description: Update useQuestionQueue hook to subscribe to SSE 'question_added' events. When event received, add question to queue and re-sort by priority. Use existing SSE pattern from plan updates. Handle deduplication check before adding.

steps.title: Add agent subscription workflow
steps.description: Add 'Subscribe to answer' button in ChatBubble when agent detects similar existing question. Call subscribeToQuestion() API. Update subscriber count in real-time. When original question is answered, notify all subscribers via SSE (backend change). Frontend receives notification and updates question as answered.

fields.currentQuestion: Question | null - the one being displayed in ChatBubble

question_interface.subscribers: string[] - other agent IDs waiting for this answer
question_interface.merged_from: string[] - question IDs that were deduplicated into this

deduplication.strategy: Match by agent_id + topic similarity (first 50 chars of question text)
deduplication.behavior: Later questions merge into earlier one, subscribers array grows

interactions.click_queue_item: Select that question, close triage, open ChatBubble

interactions.dismiss_fyi: Remove all FYI-level questions from queue
